texto: To locate a missing phrase, look for words that connect it to the above: **det** (that), **den** (that), **derfor** (that's why), **dog** (however).
If the phrase starts with **Det** or **Den**, it usually refers to something already mentioned.
First read the whole text, then the questions. So you know what information to look for and don't waste time.
Short answers: copy the exact word, but change the form if needed.

frases.da: København er kendt for sine cykler.
frases.es: Copenhague es conocida por sus bicicletas.
frases.en: Copenhagen is known for its bikes.

frases.da: Mange bruger cyklen hver dag, også om vinteren.
frases.es: Muchos usan la bici cada día, también en invierno.
frases.en: Many use the bike every day, also in winter.

frases.da: Det har en klar fordel: man er hurtig i byen.
frases.es: Eso tiene una clara ventaja: se va rápido por la ciudad.
frases.en: That has a clear advantage: it goes fast in the city.

frases.da: Dog er der også udfordringer, fordi cykelstierne er små.
frases.es: Sin embargo, también hay retos, porque los carriles bici son pequeños.
frases.en: However, there are also challenges, because the bike lanes are small.
analisis: because the bike lanes are small

frases.da: Derfor arbejder byen på at gøre dem større.
frases.es: Por eso la ciudad trabaja para hacerlos más grandes.
frases.en: That's why the city works to make them bigger.

bloques.pregunta: In the text, what word does «sin embargo» mean?

opciones.explicacion: It's the contrast connector of the text.

bloques.pregunta: What does «Det» mean in «Det har en klar fordel»?

opciones.texto: The bike (the use of the bike)
opciones.explicacion: What is mentioned above: use the bike.
It's the subject, but not what you mean.

bloques.frase: ___ har en klar fordel: man er hurtig i byen.

opciones.explicacion: Neutral title that summarizes the above.

bloques.frase: Derfor arbejder byen på at gøre dem større.

opciones.texto: That's why the city works to make them bigger.
The city works to make them big, though.
The city has already made them big.

bloques.traduccion: Many use the bike every day

opciones.explicacion: Something that needs to be overcome.

bloques.pregunta: How do you say «That's why.» in Danish?

intro: In the PD3 examination there are long texts. Today you learn to find the main idea and the words that unite the phrases.
